approvals.note: Leif approved this change's scope himself on 2026-11-13 after the coordinator agent's (claude-code-t370) summary: the printed archive-restore step reads archive paths literally, puts -- before the change id, and prints control bytes in a directory name as text. The REQ-change-093 delta adds one acceptance line under HI CHANGE-7.b (Leif, 2026-11-06, 'Capture both'); the coordinator checked that wording and judged it aligned. Prepared and recorded by claude-code-t38p.

approved_scope.title: Print archive restore steps that Git and SpecSync read literally, with control bytes shown as text
approved_scope.description: Print archive restore steps that Git and SpecSync read literally, with control bytes shown as text
acceptance_criteria: the printed corrupt-archive restore puts back only the named package when its path holds * or ?, and the printed archiving-commit lookup and the probes read it literally; every printed specsync change status command reads an id that begins with - as the id; a package path holding a newline or escape byte is printed with no control byte and, run through bash, still restores that exact directory

answers.constraints: #901: every word interpolated into a printed step is quoted as one shell word and the step is built from literals, the id and the package path only, never a digest; CHANGE-7.a.2: the printed step is the exact restore command
